summary: Small library: a KeyframeData record plus three keyframe extractors (FfProbe, FfTool-stub, Matroska). Port KeyframeData + the FfProbe extractor faithfully (the FfProbe tests are the parity oracle). The Matroska extractor depends on the C# NEbml package's random-access EbmlReader (ReadAt/EnterContainer/LeaveContainer over absolute stream positions); no Rust EBML crate offers the same seek-based cursor idiomatically, so it is DEFERRED for Wave 0.

portable_types.name: KeyframeData
portable_types.note: Public class: `long TotalDuration` (ticks) + `IReadOnlyList<long> KeyframeTicks`. Port as a plain Rust struct with pub fields `total_duration: i64` and `keyframe_ticks: Vec<i64>` (or `Box<[i64]>`). Add `#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]` with PascalCase field renames (`TotalDuration`, `KeyframeTicks`) so it round-trips the *_result.json parity fixtures via serde_json. C# ctor arg order is (totalDuration, keyframeTicks).

portable_types.name: FfProbeKeyframeExtractor
portable_types.note: Two functions. (1) `GetKeyframeData(ffProbePath, filePath)` spawns the ffprobe process with the exact arg string and pipes stdout into ParseStream — port as a function that runs std::process::Command and feeds the reader to parse. (2) `ParseStream(reader)` is the CORE PORTABLE LOGIC and the test target: read CSV lines; on `packet,<ptsTime>,<flags>` lines whose flags start with `K_`, parse ptsTime as invariant-culture f64 and push `(pts * 10_000_000).round-to-i64` ticks (TicksPerSecond = 10_000_000); on `stream,<dur>` set streamDuration if it parses as f64; on `format,<dur>` set formatDuration. Non-parseable values (e.g. `stream,N/A`) are ignored. Final duration = streamDuration if >0 else formatDuration; TotalDuration = (duration_seconds * 10_000_000) as ticks via TimeSpan.FromSeconds(d).Ticks. IMPORTANT precision notes: keyframe conversion uses Convert.ToInt64(keyframe * 10_000_000) which is banker's/round-half-to-even on the raw double — must match to pass parity; duration goes through TimeSpan.FromSeconds which truncates to 100ns tick resolution. lineType comparisons are OrdinalIgnoreCase. Split on FIRST comma for type, then the rest split again on its first comma for packet time/flags.

deferred.name: FfToolKeyframeExtractor
deferred.reason: C# body is `=> throw new NotImplementedException()`. No logic to port. Reproduce as a stub function returning an Err/unimplemented (or a `NotImplemented`-style error) to preserve the API surface; no tests exercise it.

deferred.name: MatroskaKeyframeExtractor
deferred.reason: DEFERRED for Wave 0 per PortJob instructions. Reads MKV via the NEbml `EbmlReader`, which exposes a random-access cursor: ReadSeekHead (parse SeekHead for Info/Tracks/Cues absolute positions), ReadAt(position) to seek, EnterContainer/LeaveContainer, ReadUInt/ReadFloat/ReadBinary, FindElement by element id. Rust EBML crates (ebml-iterable/webm-iterable) are pull-iterators without the same ReadAt seek-by-offset semantics, and matroska/symphonia-format-mkv are metadata/demux layers that don't expose Cue CuePoint positions the same way. Porting requires either (a) a minimal custom EBML reader supporting vint id/size + absolute seek, or (b) wrapping a crate and re-deriving Cues positions. No test fixture / parity oracle exists for the Matroska path in this test project, so it is safe to defer. Depends on the DEFERRED helper types below.

deferred.name: MatroskaConstants
deferred.reason: EBML element-id constants (SegmentContainer, SeekHead, Seek, Info, TimestampScale, Duration, Tracks, TrackEntry, TrackNumber, TrackType, TrackTypeVideo=0x1, TrackTypeSubtitle=0x11, Cues, CueTime, CuePoint, CueTrackPositions, CuePointTrackNumber). Only meaningful together with the deferred Matroska extractor; port as `const u64`/enum when Matroska lands in Wave 5.

deferred.name: EbmlReaderExtensions
deferred.reason: Extension methods over NEbml's EbmlReader (FindElement, ReadUIntFromBinary, ReadSeekHead, ReadInfo, FindFirstTrackNumberByType). Tightly coupled to NEbml's API; ports only alongside the chosen Rust EBML strategy in Wave 5.

deferred.name: Info (Matroska.Models.Info)
deferred.reason: Internal data holder: `long TimestampScale` (ns) + `double? Duration`. Trivial struct, but only used by the deferred Matroska extractor; defer with it.

deferred.name: SeekHead (Matroska.Models.SeekHead)
deferred.reason: Internal data holder: InfoPosition/TracksPosition/CuesPosition (i64 relative offsets). Only used by the deferred Matroska extractor; defer with it.

constants_of_note.name: TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond
constants_of_note.note: 1 tick = 100 ns. Load-bearing for both TotalDuration and per-keyframe tick conversion; NOT a candidate setting — it is a fixed .NET semantic the parity fixtures encode.

needs_external_crate: For the DEFERRED Matroska path (Wave 5): candidate Rust EBML/MKV crates surveyed — ebml-iterable / webm-iterable (low-level EBML iterator, closest to NEbml but no ReadAt seek), matroska (metadata parser), symphonia-format-mkv (demuxer). None is a drop-in for NEbml's random-access ReadAt cursor; a minimal custom EBML seek reader is likely required. Not needed for Wave 0.
behavioral_constants: TicksPerSecond = 10_000_000 (1 tick = 100ns) — used for both TotalDuration and per-keyframe conversion.
Keyframe tick = round_half_to_even(pts_seconds * 10_000_000) as i64 (C# Convert.ToInt64 of a double).
duration = stream_duration if stream_duration > 0 else format_duration.
Only packets whose flags field starts with 'K_' are counted as keyframes.
Numeric parsing is InvariantCulture / AllowDecimalPoint; unparseable values (e.g. 'N/A') are silently skipped.
Line-type match is case-insensitive (OrdinalIgnoreCase); split on first comma for type, remainder split on its first comma for packet pts/flags.
